image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a blue sky. The central element is a weathered, cylindrical post (appearing to be concrete or painted metal) with a complex, somewhat distorted mounting bracket at the top. Two blue rectangular street signs extend from the post. The text on the signs is illegible gibberish, resembling alien script or corrupted characters rather than standard typography. There are visible structural anomalies where the signs attach to the post, and the top of the post appears to melt into a non-functional shape.
